Class GroveTemperatureV12

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors.GroveTemperatureV12
All Implemented Interfaces:
SampleProvider, Thermometer
public final class GroveTemperatureV12 extends Object implements Thermometer, SampleProvider
Reads Seeed's Grove Temperature Sensor v1.2. The module is a 100-kilohm thermistor divider; this driver exposes both the raw ADC count and Seeed's v1.2 B-constant conversion. It allocates nothing.

      public float celsius(int analogPin)
      Reads and converts the thermistor voltage to degrees Celsius using the v1.2 Beta equation. Returns Float.NaN when the ADC is at either rail, where the divider resistance is undefined.
